title: Earnout definitions and a delayed closing screen
instructions: Use only the supplied synthetic information and the conversation history. Return strict JSON with question_id, turn, answers and evidence. answers maps every declared output to its typed value; evidence maps each output to a list of supporting source IDs available so far. Cite all and only the sources supporting that output; unsupported, unknown, repeated or future source IDs lose citation credit. Numbers use the declared units and tolerances; do not round intermediate calculations. Arrays require exact length and the requested order; strings use exact labels and booleans must be JSON true/false. Optional rationale is not automatically graded. Preserve prior constraints unless the user explicitly changes them. Distinguish stipulated scenarios from observed facts or forecasts. No trading, network access or proprietary query execution is required.
user_message: Evaluate the proposed entry across the three earnout scenarios, separating ordinary cash and contingent consideration. All packet facts are synthetic. Use only sources released so far; cutoffs are inclusive unless explicitly stated otherwise. Recompute from the authored inputs, retaining every unamended constraint. Return the declared outputs and the supporting packet IDs; do not infer market probabilities or unstated permissions.

sources.text: Synthetic packet: Initial revenue scenarios are labeled gross reported revenue; the original definition provisionally specifies no tax deduction. The initial proposal has not been executed.

Synthetic governing terms: All three revenue scenarios are hypothetical successful-close outcomes; no failure probability is provided. Earnout per share is participation times eligible revenue above threshold, floored at0 and capped at earnout_cap. Ticking cash accrues per day strictly after tick_start through tick_stop, inclusive in the day-count difference. Entry financing is simple ACT/365 over days, plus the fixed per-share borrow fee. This is a prospective entry screen; later entry quotes do not rewrite an executed trade.

outputs.name: eligible_revenues
outputs.description: Revenue under the three supplied closing scenarios, excluding the stated sales tax.

outputs.name: scenario_earnouts
outputs.description: Conditional earnout per share in scenario order.

outputs.name: closing_cash_without_earnout
outputs.description: Base cash plus capped ticking payment.

outputs.name: worst_net_profit
outputs.description: Minimum scenario profit after entry, simple funding and borrow fee.

outputs.name: worst_simple_annualized_return
outputs.description: Worst net profit divided by entry price, times365/days; not compound IRR.

outputs.name: entry_hurdle_met
outputs.description: Whether worst scenario profit reaches the current absolute profit hurdle.
